title: Roasted White Fish with Tomato and Olive Sauce
blurb: Flaky white fish baked with a Mediterranean sauce of tomatoes, Kalamata olives and garlic
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel and slice the onion into thin half-moons, then peel and finely chop the garlic.
Heat half the olive oil in an ovenproof dish on the hob over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Chop the tomatoes into rough chunks and add them to the dish with half the salt and some pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes until the tomatoes break down into a sauce.
Pit the olives if needed and stir them into the sauce. Chop most of the parsley, keeping some leaves whole for garnish.
Pat the fish dry and season both sides with the remaining salt and pepper. Nestle the fillets into the sauce.
Drizzle the remaining olive oil over the fish and transfer the dish to the oven. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
Scatter the chopped and whole parsley over the top before serving.
